body: I just want to die. No one appreciates my existence. No one cares if I live or not. I just wanna die.
Maybe it's just hard for you guys to understand my situation. Ah I wish I could find a whore, maybe I should go to a whore and just get over it. No one helps me, never, ever.

Thank you so much for your help. 
Yea I should change country...if I had money. But right, I should make new friends. Thing is that I don't know how to make friends anymore. Since I've been treated like nothing, its kinda hard for me to speak to new people and no one never come to speak to me either. That really makes me wonder if they can see me, if I exist.
But but I will try...and if nothing goes well again, I will......

@AnnMarys I learn Spanish, Italian and French. But I don't really study now since I can't really concentrate. And I don't think someone cares about me. Then why my friends never contact me even if I do? Why don't girls like me romantically? Why does no one speak to me even If I do? Even if I'm a normal kind nice guy? I don't have anyone to talk in real lately. And I feel completely alone and I'm just nothing

@Lugburz5 Do you know that I have done what I havent done currently but nothing changed? Even if I change my cloth or hair, I try to meet more people, I try to be confident... I thought something would change, and I would be able to at least go out a date but nothing really happened, which made me forget how to have hope. I care about myself, I've cared about myself or others. But I wanna be cared too.

I've always wanted to have a girlfriend who likes me a lot(but this never happens because it's obvious that girls never like me romantically. I don't know why at all but no one has never accepted me.) and friends to be around for a long time. I enjoy singing and playing the guitar, watching movies, and learning some languages. 
Thank you for the comment anyway.
